reviews.text:
just downloaded imo, and honestly, my first experience has been really frustrating. The country code is stuck on the United States, and I can’t change it to my own country. I can’t even get past this basic step to register my phone number.

It’s ridiculous that such a simple and essential feature doesn’t work properly. I expected a much smoother experience, but instead, I’m already having problems before I can even use the app.

An app that requires a phone number to sign up should at least make sure users can select their country without any issues. This is a basic requirement, not some advanced feature.
